hero.eyebrow: // Gilberto Espinoza · Tech Consultant & Data Analyst
hero.sub: The tech landscape is overwhelming and uncertain. I bring orientation, clarity, and data-driven insight — so you make smarter decisions and actually understand what’s happening in your business.
about.label: // 01 — About
about.title:
Tech insight
made human.
about.body: I’m Gilberto Espinoza — a computer scientist, analyst, and entrepreneur. I help businesses and founders navigate the uncertainty of modern technology with grounded data, honest advice, and real solutions.
services.label: // 02 — Services
services.title:
What I do
for you.
services.sub: Every service is delivered with transparency and context. You don’t just get a deliverable — you get the understanding behind it.
services.s1.title: Data & Statistics
services.s1.desc: I transform raw numbers into clear narratives. From descriptive stats to predictive models — I make data tell you what your business needs.
services.s2.title: Web Development
services.s2.desc: Custom websites and web applications built with real code. Clean architecture, fast performance, and designed to convert visitors into clients.
services.s3.title: Market Research
services.s3.desc: I study what your customers actually need. Surveys, data collection, competitor analysis, and structured insights to guide your strategy.
services.s4.title: Content Strategy
services.s4.desc: Bilingual content that leads to customers. Posts, campaigns, and digital presence managed with a clear audience strategy — not guesswork.
process.label: // 03 — How I Work
process.title:
From question
to clarity.
process.s1.title: Listen
process.s1.body: I start by understanding your business, your goals, and what’s actually confusing or broken right now.
process.s2.title: Analyze
process.s2.body: I dig into your data, your market, and your tech stack. I find patterns and problems most people miss.
process.s3.title: Build
process.s3.body: Whether it’s a dashboard, a website, or a content plan — I deliver real, working solutions. No fluff.
process.s4.title: Explain
process.s4.body: I make sure you understand everything. The insight is yours to keep — not locked in a black box.
banner.title: Ready to make sense of your data?
banner.body: Whether you’re a startup, a growing SME, or just someone who’s tired of guessing — I can help you go from confusion to clarity.
